description.text: Country property. 12.04 Acres. Close proximity to town.

This home is a JEWEL-just waiting for someone to put the finishing touches on and restore it to all of it's former glory! Some great work has already been done and this home would be a perfect candidate for a REHAB loan to finish the few items that are left. This large custom built home features three bedrooms, 2 1/2 baths, two large living areas and a spectacular custom kitchen that is a MUST SEE with saltillo-look tile, granite countertops and a beautiful fireplace in the breakfast area! The master bath has been remodeled with modern cabinetry and finishes. The large lot has tons of potential with an in-ground pool (needs work) and mature landscaping providing privacy. This home is being sold AS-IS. Will not qualify for FHA. Sellers will consider all reasonable offers!

CLEAN, COZY and WELL-KEPT! Enjoy comfortable living in this well-maintained single-wide mobile home situated on an extra-large city lot. This home features a sunny and spacious living area, two bedrooms and two beautifully updated bathrooms. The inviting country-style kitchen and dining area includes a newer gas stove, nice cabinetry and pantry for storage. You'll appreciate the newer carpet and quality laminate flooring throughout. A durable metal roof offers low-maintenance protection, while the sturdy metal fence provides privacy and security. The large custom metal carport offers convenient covered parking. Whether you're looking for an affordable primary residence, an investment opportunity, or a place to downsize without sacrificing comfort, this property combines practical updates, very low utility bills, generous outdoor space and small-town charm in one attractive package! This home is not on a permanent foundation and is only eligible for cash purchase, conventional loan or private financing. Schedule your showing today!

Experience the best of country living on just over 15 acres, where wide-open Eastern New Mexico skies, privacy, and modern amenities come together just minutes from town. Horses are welcome, and with ample RV parking, there's plenty of room for all your vehicles, equipment, and outdoor toys. Inside, you'll find a bright, open-concept floor plan highlighted by vaulted ceilings that seamlessly connect the living, dining, and kitchen areas. The thoughtfully designed kitchen features abundant cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, a pantry, breakfast bar, and a dedicated coffee bar, making it ideal for everyday living and entertaining. New luxury blinds throughout the home add both style and functionality. The spacious primary suite offers a large en suite bathroom and an impressive walk-in closet. A secondary bedroom also features its own private full bath, providing an ideal setup for guests or multigenerational living. All four bedrooms are generously sized and include walk-in closets. Additional interior features include an oversized laundry room, a versatile bonus room perfect for a home office, hobby space, or extra storage, and a whole-home water filtration system for added convenience. The oversized attached garage features a 10' x 17' garage door, providing excellent clearance for larger vehicles and equipment. Recent owner improvements include two newly planted cherry trees, a new dishwasher, and a covered carport addition alongside the garage. If you've been searching for a property that offers space to spread out, modern comforts, room for horses, RV parking, and the peace of country living without giving up the conveniences of town, this exceptional property is ready to welcome you home. Call today to schedule your private showing!
This home will not qualify for financing. Great investment opportunity for a flip or a rental on an extra deep corner lot!

If you're looking for a country property close to town check out this 3 bedroom 2 bath doublewide on 2 acres on a permanent foundation. newer windows. 2 carport, awesome enclosed front porch, storage shed and plenty out buildings. Fenced all around. Property is move in ready. Home next door is also for sale and can be purchased together.

Located just minutes from Eastern New Mexico University and outside the flood zone, this well-maintained brick home is full of charm and quality features. Inside, you'll find elegant crown molding, beautiful wood cabinetry, tile flooring in the kitchen, and comfortable carpeting in the bedrooms and hallway. The home offers a functional layout with a single-car garage, a utility closet with additional storage, and a spacious backyard complete with a handy workshop. The yard has been well maintained and is shaded by several mature trees, creating an inviting outdoor space. A cinder block fence encloses two sides of the backyard, with a wood privacy fence on the shared side. Additional peace of mind comes from a roof that was replaced in late 2024. This property has been exceptionally cared for and is ready for its next owner. Don't miss your opportunity to own this gem-schedule your private showing today before it's gone!

This well-maintained 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom home is a great opportunity for a first-time homebuyer or investor! The home is well insulated for added comfort and energy efficiency, while the roof is less than five years old. Plumbing beneath the home has also been updated all the way to the alley, providing added peace of mind. Whether you're looking for an affordable place to call home or your next rental property, this home is full of potential! Home is sold AS-IS, cash or conventional loan only.

With over 2,400 square feet of living space, this well-maintained home offers room for everyone to spread out and enjoy. Featuring 3bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and a desirable split floor plan, the spacious primary suite is thoughtfully separated from the secondary bedrooms and includes an oversized walk-in closet. Beautiful hardwood floors add warmth and character throughout much of the home, while updated appliances and a newer HVAC system installed in 2023 offer modern comfort and peace of mind. The home also features two sunrooms, providing flexible space for a home office, hobby room, workout area, or additional living space.Situated on an oversized lot of more than a quarter acre, the outdoor space is just as impressive with a covered patio, block fence, and plenty of room for entertaining, gardening, or simply enjoying the outdoors. If you're looking for space, comfort, and updates, this home is a must-see.
Large 1700+sq ft home on corner lot, updated bathrooms, newer flooring, and lots of light! Lovely solid surface flooring, fresh paint, this one is move in ready at an affordable price!
